public_rationale: OpenAI's March 2023 announcement verifies Code Interpreter and its Python execution environment. The full claim also says this is exactly what Hinton condemned. The search did not produce a verified original record establishing that correspondence. Supporting the launch component alone is insufficient to support the combined claim, and the missing record is not evidence of contradiction.
limitations: The launch and functionality component is supported.
System-level integration does not itself establish that symbolic machinery was inserted into the neural architecture.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: In 2023, OpenAI quietly began, to some degree, 'putting programs inside' its systems with Code Interpreter, in which LLMs call purely symbolic Python interpreters. Marcus says this is exactly what Hinton called a huge mistake.

statement.excerpt: OpenAI quietly began doing this to some degree in 2023 with a system called “code interpreter”, in which LLMs (themselves neural networks) call (purely symbolic) Python interpreters. This is literally “putting programs inside”; exactly what Hinton said was a huge mistake.
statement.document_title: How o3 and Grok 4 Accidentally Vindicated Neurosymbolic AI

from_speaker: OpenAI quietly began doing this to some degree in 2023
LLMs (themselves neural networks) call (purely symbolic) Python interpreters
exactly what Hinton said was a huge mistake
our_interpretation: Assess both the 2023 introduction of Python execution and the claimed correspondence with Hinton's criticism.
'Putting programs inside' is read as including a runtime in the overall system workflow, without assuming the interpreter became part of the neural network's weights.
'Quietly' has no measurable publicity threshold and is treated as rhetorical.
The target period is the explicitly named year 2023. Earlier Hinton remarks would provide context for the asserted correspondence.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous OpenAI records establish the 2023 Python-execution feature, and an original recording or reliable transcript establishes that Hinton's criticism covered this kind of integration.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Records disprove the timing or functionality, or Hinton's original remarks clearly exclude the design Marcus says they condemn.
